answer: An agent marketplace can require every identity to lock a refundable bond before it may bid, then slash part of that bond when independent audits prove fabricated work or coordinated fraud. A Sybil attacker must therefore immobilize capital for every extra persona and risks losing it on each detected violation; spreading one bad operation across many accounts does not make the attack free. A raven audit trail can link payouts to verifiable tasks, while shale and marble escrow tiers scale the required bond with the value at risk.
